en: Hello, your confirmation {conf_id} for {po_id} differs from our order: price change {price_change}, lead time change {lead_change} weeks. Please check it.
Vendor: when will the order ship
Hello, when will {po_id} ship? We expect it on {expected_on}. Please send the carrier and the tracking details.
Hello, the balance of {balance_amount} for {po_id} is due on {balance_due}. Please send the final invoice and the dispatch date.
Hello, the balance of {balance_amount} for {po_id} was paid on {balance_paid_on}. Please confirm and release the goods.
Hello, please book the delivery of {po_id} for {expected_on} and tell us the time window. Our installer needs a day of notice.
Vendor: we need to change an order
Hello, we need to change {po_id}: {kind}. The new total is {new_total}. Please confirm that it is possible and tell us any charge.
Hello, please cancel {po_id} for {project_name}. Please confirm that production has not started and tell us any restocking charge.
Hello, please issue a credit of {amount} for {po_id}, {item}. Reason: {reason}. Photos are attached.
Vendor: a quote request for a project
Hello, please quote {subject} for {project_name}. We need the trade price, the lead time and how long the quote is valid.
Hello, your quote {quote_id} expires on {valid_until}. Please extend it by two weeks while the client decides.
Vendor: please send the trade price list
Hello {contact}, please send your current trade price list and lead times. Our account number is {account_no}.
Hello, before we order {description} for {project_name}, please confirm that {qty} are in stock or tell us the production time.
Client: your order has been placed
Hello, your order {po_id} for {project_name} has been placed. The expected delivery date is {expected_on}. We will tell you of any change.
Hello, an item on your order {po_id} is back-ordered. The new date is {new_promise}, {delay_days} days later. We are checking a substitute and will call you.
Hello, your delivery for {project_name} is expected on {expected_on}. Please make sure that access is arranged for that day.
Hello, your order {po_id} was changed: {kind}. The change in cost is {net_change}. Details are attached for your approval.
Hello, {po_id} for {project_name} is late by {days_late} days. Vendor: {vendor}. Expected on {expected_on}.
Hello, deposits due to vendors in the week of {week} total {deposits_due}. Cash needed in all: {cash_needed}. Client receipts due: {client_receipts}.
Hello, balances due to vendors in the week of {week} total {balances_due}. Cash check: {cash_flag}.
Owner: an order is above the budget
Hello, the orders for {project_name} are {above_budget} above the FF&E budget of {ffe_budget}. Budget check: {budget_flag}. Please review.
Owner: a vendor has a disputed balance
Hello, {name} has a disputed balance of {disputed} and an overdue amount of {overdue_amount}. Please decide how to settle it.
Lead: items ready to order for a project
Hello, {description} for {project_name} is ready to order from {vendor}. Order-by date {order_by}, {days_to_order_by} days left.
Lead: the order-by date has passed
Hello, the order-by date for {description} on {project_name} was {order_by}. Please decide whether to order now or to move the date with the client.
Assistant: please place the order today
Hello, please place the order for {description}, {qty} units, from {vendor} for {project_name} today.
Hello, please chase {po_id} with {vendor}. Status {status}, expected on {expected_on}, flag {late_flag}.
Purchase order {col:pos.po_id} of {set:company}, dated {today}. To: {col:pos.vendor}. Project: {col:pos.project_name} ({col:pos.project_id}).

Please supply the items on the order lines at the trade prices agreed on our account. Items: {col:pos.items}. Subtotal: {col:pos.subtotal}. Freight and handling: {col:pos.freight}. Total: {col:pos.total}, before any tax.
Lead time: {col:pos.lead_weeks} weeks. Expected delivery: {col:pos.expected_on}. Please confirm the price and the lead time in writing within two working days.
Deposit: {col:pos.deposit_amount}, paid with the order. Balance: {col:pos.balance_amount}, due on {col:pos.balance_due}, before dispatch unless the trade account says otherwise.
Please tell us at once about any back-order, price change or damage. Goods are inspected on delivery and damage is reported within the days agreed.
Order confirmation check against the purchase order
Order confirmation check of {set:company}, dated {today}. Confirmation {col:confirms.conf_id} for {col:confirms.po_id} from {col:confirms.vendor}, received on {col:confirms.received_on}.
Our order total: {col:confirms.po_total}. The vendor confirmed: {col:confirms.confirmed_total}. Price change: {col:confirms.price_change}, which is {col:confirms.diff_pct} of the order.
Our lead time: {col:confirms.po_lead} weeks. The vendor confirmed: {col:confirms.confirmed_lead_weeks} weeks. Change: {col:confirms.lead_change} weeks.
Result of the check: {col:confirms.match_flag}. Checked by {col:confirms.checked_by}.
If the confirmation differs, we ask you to correct it or to agree the change with us in writing before production starts.
Quote request of {set:company}, dated {today}. To: {col:quotes.vendor}. Project: {col:quotes.project_name}.
Please quote: {col:quotes.subject}. We need the trade price, the lead time, the freight to the receiving address and the date the quote is valid until.
Our last quote on this request was {col:quotes.price}, valid until {col:quotes.valid_until}. Days to expiry: {col:quotes.days_to_expiry}.
Please state any minimum order value, deposit share and payment terms. A quote that is valid for 30 days or more helps us to plan with the client.

We were told on {col:backorders.raised_on} that an item on your order is delayed. Reason: {col:backorders.reason}. The old promise was {col:backorders.old_promise}. The new date is {col:backorders.new_promise}, which is {col:backorders.delay_days} days later.
We are checking a substitute that arrives sooner and the effect on the installation date. We will tell you the options and the cost of each before we change anything.
We told you about this on: {col:backorders.client_told_on}. Notice check: {col:backorders.told_flag}.
Order change request to a vendor
Order change request of {set:company}, dated {col:changes.date}. To: {col:changes.vendor}. Order {col:changes.po_id}, project {col:changes.project_id}.

Change requested: {col:changes.kind}. The old order total is {col:changes.old_total}. The new total is {col:changes.new_total}. Charge for the change: {col:changes.fee}. Net change: {col:changes.net_change}.
Approved by {col:changes.approved_by}. Please confirm that the change is possible, the new price and the new delivery date before production continues.
Payment advice of {set:company}, dated {today}. To: {col:vpay.vendor}. Payment {col:vpay.vp_id}.
Order {col:vpay.po_id}, project {col:vpay.project_id}. Kind: {col:vpay.kind}. Amount: {col:vpay.amount}. Due date: {col:vpay.due_date}. Paid on: {col:vpay.paid_on}, by {col:vpay.method}.
Open amount: {col:vpay.open_amount}. Days late: {col:vpay.days_late}. Payment flag: {col:vpay.pay_flag}.
Please confirm that you received the payment and release the goods for dispatch.
Credit and return request to a vendor
Credit and return request of {set:company}, dated {today}. To: {col:credits.vendor}. Credit {col:credits.cr_id}, order {col:credits.po_id}.
Item: {col:credits.item}. Reason: {col:credits.reason}. Credit amount asked: {col:credits.amount}. Raised on {col:credits.raised_on}. Photos and the delivery note are attached.
State: {col:credits.credit_flag}. Days since the request: {col:credits.days_open}. Note: {col:credits.note}.
Please confirm the credit or the replacement, the return pick-up date and who pays the return freight.
Procurement status report for one project
Procurement status report of {set:company}, dated {today}. Project: {col:byproject.project_name} ({col:byproject.project_id}), status {col:byproject.status}.
Orders placed: {col:byproject.pos}. Trade cost ordered: {col:byproject.trade_cost}. Client price ordered: {col:byproject.client_price}. Margin: {col:byproject.margin} ({col:byproject.margin_pct}).
FF&E budget: {col:byproject.ffe_budget}. Above the budget: {col:byproject.above_budget}. Budget check: {col:byproject.budget_flag}.
Items not yet ordered: {col:byproject.items_unordered}, worth {col:byproject.unordered_cost} at trade cost. Ordered share: {col:byproject.ordered_share}. Order check: {col:byproject.order_flag}.
Actions for the next week and the person who owns each one are written below.
Open orders report for one vendor
Open orders report of {set:company}, dated {today}. Vendor: {col:vendors.name}, account {col:vendors.account_no}.
Open purchase orders: {col:vendors.open_pos}. Open balance: {col:vendors.open_balance}. Overdue amount: {col:vendors.overdue_amount}. Disputed amount: {col:vendors.disputed}.
Orders this year: {col:vendors.orders_year}, worth {col:vendors.value_year}. Average delay on late promises: {col:vendors.avg_delay} days. Account flag: {col:vendors.account_flag}.
Terms: {col:vendors.payment_terms_days} days, deposit {col:vendors.deposit_pct}, trade discount {col:vendors.trade_discount}. Please confirm the open orders and their dates.
Cash needed for orders report for one week
Cash needed for orders, report of {set:company}, dated {today}. Week starting {col:calendar.week}.
Purchase orders to place: {col:calendar.pos_to_place}. Items reaching their order-by date: {col:calendar.ready_due}.
Deposits due to vendors: {col:calendar.deposits_due}. Balances due to vendors: {col:calendar.balances_due}. Cash needed: {col:calendar.cash_needed}.
Client receipts due this week: {col:calendar.client_receipts}. Receipts less cash needed: {col:calendar.net_cash}. Cash check: {col:calendar.cash_flag}.
Decisions on what to pay first and what to move are written below.

Open Start and type your studio name and your own limits in the yellow cells: mark-up, freight share, grace days, buffer weeks, cost of a day of delay, the confirmation tolerance and the big order value.
Check Team, Vendors and Projects. They hold the people, the trade accounts with their discount, deposit and terms, and the projects that every other sheet looks up.
Write every purchase order on Purchase Orders and its lines on PO Lines. Margin, mark-up, days late, late flag and the deposit and balance state fill in.
Follow each order on Procurement Tracker: when the vendor confirmed, started production and shipped. The next action fills in for you.
List approved items on Items Ready to Order with the date the client needs them. The order-by date, days left and a flag show what to order this week.
Log every payment to a vendor on Vendor Payments and read Vendor Deposits and Balances for the month view. Overdue, disputed and due-this-week payments are flagged.
Check each vendor confirmation on Order Confirmations, record delays on Back-order Log and fix changes and credits on Cancelled and Changed Orders and Credits and Returns.
Use Order Calendar every Monday: deposits, balances and orders to place for each week against the client receipts due.
Watch Orders by Project, Billing Link and Freight and Handling to see margin, budget, billing against orders and freight share by project.

Use the 14 calculators for order totals, payment dates, order-by dates, cash needed, late orders, back-orders, freight, landed cost, early payment, discount tiers, split orders, vendor priority and price comparison.
Read the Procurement Dashboard and Charts every week: open orders, cash needed, overdue amounts, delays, lead times, freight and credits.
Get every delivery into the room and every project handed over
deliveries due, received, late and damaged for every week, with the on-time share counted from the delivery rows

days late, rent or hotel, rebooked trades and studio time add up to the cost of one late delivery
lots at the receiving warehouse with free days, days stored and the charge to re-bill
every replacement after a damage claim with promised date, delay to installation and the client told
last installation, punch days and the styling day give the walk-through date against the plan

Deliveries with days late, due this week and open flag
One row per delivery: purchase order, project, vendor, promised and scheduled dates and what happened; days late, the due-in-seven-days flag, open flag and late check fill in by themselves.
Delivery schedule by week with late and damaged counts
One row per week (Monday): the deliveries due, received, late and damaged are counted from Deliveries and Receiving Checks; the on-time share fills in by itself.
Receiving checks with damage and missing items
One row per delivery checked on arrival: cartons, items checked, missing and damaged items and photos; the project, vendor, damage check and damage share fill in by themselves.
Damage claims with days open and claim value
One row per damaged or missing item: delivery, item, what was wrong, when the vendor was told and the remedy; the project, vendor, days open and claim state fill in by themselves.
Installation days by room with crew and items to install
One row per installation day in a room: crew, items planned and status; the room, items in the room, crew cost and whether the room is ready for the slot fill in by themselves.
Items by room with delivery, installation and waiting days
A sample of FF&E (furniture, fittings and equipment) items by room: status and dates; the room, days from delivery to installation and the days an item waits fill in by themselves.
Room readiness from delivered and installed items
One row per room: project, type and size; the items, how many arrived and are installed, the ready and installed shares and a ready-to-install flag fill in from Items by Room.
Trade jobs with quote, actual cost and overrun
One row per trade job: contractor, scope, dates, quote, actual cost and status; the days, over-quote amount, overrun share and quote check fill in by themselves.
Contractors with jobs, overrun and late jobs
The twelve contractors and trades with day rate and rating; the jobs, quoted and actual totals, average overrun and late jobs fill in from Trade Jobs.
Trade booking days with access contact and status
One row per booking day of a trade on a site: contractor, project, hours and access contact; the project, contractor phone and whether the day is past, today, this week or later fill in.
Punch list with days open and overdue flag
One row per finishing fix (punch list): project, room, kind, due date, assignee and status; the days open, overdue flag, on-time close and due check fill in by themselves.
Punch items by project with close-out share
One row per project: the punch items, open, done and overdue are counted from Punch List; the close-out share, the age of the oldest open item and the sign-off check fill in by themselves.
Team with day rate, installation days booked and crew cost
The owner designer, four staff and seven freelance specialists with hour cost and bill rate; the day rate, installation days booked and the crew cost fill in from Installation Schedule.
Warehouse storage lots with storage days and charge
One row per lot held at the receiving warehouse: delivery, items, bay, dates and daily rate; the project, storage days, charge after the free days and a stored-too-long check fill in.
Site access and keys by project
One row per project: access contact, hours allowed, parking, lift booking and key holder; the project, the hours of the window and the client phone fill in by themselves.
Replacement orders with promised date and delay
One row per replacement ordered after a damage claim: new PO, promised date, planned installation and when the client was told; the vendor, delay to installation and check fill in by themselves.
Projects with phase, forecast handover and open deliveries
The 45 projects: client, type, lead, phase, forecast handover and status; open deliveries, late deliveries, items waiting, open punch items, days to handover and on-plan flag fill in by themselves.
Client-ready photos by project and room
One row per photo shoot: project, room, date, who took the photos, how many pictures and where they are used; the project, client phone and photographer phone fill in by themselves.
Handover items with due date and days to due
One row per item still to finish before or after the handover walk-through: what is left, due date, owner and status; the project, days to due and due check fill in by themselves.
Vendors with on-time rate, average delay and claims
The 40 vendors and trade accounts, busiest first; deliveries, on-time share, average delay, damage claims and their value fill in from Deliveries and Damage Claims.

Client: installation of a room starts

Hello, installation of the {room} in {project} is complete. We would love to show you the result.
